filename.Description: The associated mri scan's filename (relative NIfTI path), matching mriscans.tsv/scans.tsv's filename column. Primary key of this table.

physio.Description: The raw physio basename (mriscans.tsv's physio column value) used to produce this row's output, as of the last conversion.

status.Description: Per-association processing outcome, regenerated every run.

Levels.CONVERTED: phys2bids read the raw file and its BIDS _physio.tsv.gz/.json were written next to the paired NIfTI.
Levels.NOT_PHYSIO: Matched a supported extension but could not be loaded as physiological data.
Levels.READER_MISSING: The optional reader package phys2bids needs for this format is not installed.
Levels.CONVERT_ERROR: phys2bids raised while converting, produced no .tsv.gz output, or its destination was already occupied by a different file.
Levels.SOURCE_MISSING: PhysioParent was unset/not a directory, the named basename was not found under it, or the mriscans.tsv row is missing participant_id/datatype.
Levels.COLLISION: This physio basename is referenced by more than one mriscans.tsv row; none of them were converted until resolved.
Levels.ROW_GONE: The mriscans.tsv row this physio conversion was associated with no longer has a matching physio association; row and any prior QC edits are preserved.

n_channels.Description: Number of channels phys2bids reported for the recording (its ch_amount, which includes the leading time channel). Blank for associations that were not loaded as physio.

sampling_frequencies.Description: Unique channel sampling frequencies in hertz, ascending, comma-separated (e.g. 1000,500). A single value for the common single-frequency case. Aligned position-by-position with sample_count and duration_seconds.

sample_count.Description: Number of samples per sampling frequency, comma-separated and aligned with sampling_frequencies (the longest channel recorded at each frequency). Blank for associations that were not loaded as physio.

duration_seconds.Description: Acquisition duration in seconds at 0.001 s precision, computed as sample_count / sampling_frequency, comma-separated and aligned with sampling_frequencies. Blank for associations that were not loaded as physio.

output_files.Description: Converted BIDS _physio.tsv.gz output path(s) relative to OUTPUT_DIR/PROJECT/, comma-separated; multiple when phys2bids split the recording by frequency. Blank when nothing was written.

bids_name.Description: The portion of each output file's basename between the participant_id[_session_id]_ prefix and the .tsv.gz extension, comma-separated and aligned with output_files. Regenerated every run from the current output(s); blank when there are none.

recommend_for_use.Description: Whether the recording is recommended for use. Empty until reviewed by an end-user.

Levels.TRUE: The recording is recommended for use.
Levels.FALSE: The recording is not recommended for use.

complete.Description: Whether the recording was acquired at its complete, as-intended length. Empty until reviewed by an end-user.

usable.Description: Whether the recording is usable at all. Empty until reviewed by an end-user.

qc_rating.Description: Acquisition quality-control rating. Empty until reviewed by an end-user.

rating_reason.Description: Free-text reason for the qc_rating, open to any string of any length. Empty by default.

qc_notes.Description: Free-text notes about the quality control not captured by other fields, open to any string of any length. Empty by default.
